resources.string: Tap the lens over any text to translate it.
Lets the lens read the text under it

Lucid reads the text that sits under its floating lens so it can translate it. It reads only that text, keeps no copy, and records nothing. With the online engine, the words under the lens are sent to Google Translate, together with the rest of that screen as context, to be translated; with the on-device engine nothing leaves the phone.
Drop the lens here to turn it off
